paper_metadata.title: Mechanism of Nb microalloying-induced eutectic structure evolution in Fe-Al-Nb alloys on mechanical/tribological properties

evidence.quote: This study investigates the effects of Nb gradient (5 – 15 wt%) on microstructure and properties of Fe-Al-Nb alloys.
The Fe -Al - Nb alloy was synthesized via SHS (formula (1)-(3)) using micron-scale raw materials provided by Hebei Wenlun Metal Materials Co., Ltd.

Each batch was then homogenized in a planetary ball mill operating at 170 rpm for 6 h, with a ball - to - powder ratio of 1:2.
Subsequently, each batch was cold - pressed into cylindrical compacts having a diameter of 78 mm under a uniaxial pressure of 50 MPa.
These green compacts were then placed in a crucible that was 27 mm thick and ignited using a combustion initiator.
Post-reaction, all products melt due to the heat generated. Under argon protection, the molten products cool in a furnace.
During the aluminothermic reaction, temperatures can exceed 3300 K.
